name: Teen Health Council (Mikva Challenge)
what_you_do: Teens study the physical, mental and sexual health of Chicago youth. They make action plans. They share ideas with the Chicago Department of Public Health and CPS. They also learn about public health careers.
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the program page. Ask Mikva Challenge.
duration: Not stated; policy work happens over the summer in past years
deadline_text: Recruitment for 2027 programs begins in spring 2027. Exact dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Recruitment for 2027 starts in the spring. Watch the Mikva Challenge program application page or email inquiries@mikvachallenge.org. Phone: (312) 863-6340.
notes: Good fit if you want to work in health or public health. The page lists a partnership with the Lurie Children's Center on Childhood Resilience.
